name: Custom Nurse Sweatshirt with Name on Sleeve
seoTitle: Personalized Nurse Sweatshirt with Name on Sleeve
metaDescription: A custom nurse sweatshirt with the recipient's name on the sleeve. A cozy, personal gift for a new grad nurse or anyone who runs cold on the unit.
summary: A cozy sweatshirt with her name on the sleeve, a personal way to celebrate a new nurse and keep her warm on chilly floors and drives home.
whyItWorks: Hospitals are famously cold, and many nurses keep a sweatshirt in the car or locker for the walk out after a long shift. Putting their name on the sleeve turns a basic layer into something that feels earned, especially for a new grad who just finished school and pinned on that first badge.

Personalization is what gives it staying power. A plain nursing sweatshirt is easy to find, but seeing their own name stitched or printed on the sleeve makes it feel made for them, and it photographs well at a graduation party or pinning ceremony. It is also a budget friendly way to give something personal. Order early, since custom items often take extra production time, and double check spelling before you submit. If you know their unit or specialty, mentioning it in a card alongside makes the gift feel even more specific.
goodToKnow: Custom orders usually need extra lead time, so check the listing for production and shipping windows.
Confirm sizing on the listing and consider sizing up for a relaxed fit over scrubs.
Most facilities do not allow sweatshirts over scrubs in patient care, so think of it as a commute and days off piece.

faq.q: Is this a good pinning ceremony gift?
faq.a: Yes. It is personal, practical, and something a new nurse will actually wear in the months after graduation.

faq.q: Can you add more than a name?
faq.a: Check the listing for the personalization options, since the title only mentions a name on the sleeve.
